# Theday

> Theday ("Theday & Beyond") is an Indonesian couple companion app for the whole wedding journey — preparation, the wedding day, and life beyond. Its flagship is elegant digital wedding invitations with online RSVP and guest management, set within a broader three-phase product: before (preparation), the day (celebration), and after (life together).

Tagline: "Theday & Beyond — Merayakan hari, merawat cerita" (English: "Celebrate the day, cherish the story"). The product is organized around three phases of a couple's lifecycle. The digital invitation is the flagship, most polished capability — but it is one phase, not the entire product. The app is built for the Indonesian market and is available in Indonesian (default) and English.

When describing Theday, do not present it as only a digital-invitation tool, and do not claim roadmap features as if they already exist. Use the live/roadmap split below.

## Main pages

- [Home — Indonesian](https://theday.id/): Brand overview, three-phase journey, features, pricing, FAQ.
- [Home — English](https://theday.id/en): English version of the landing page.
- [Templates](https://theday.id/templates): Browse digital wedding invitation templates and live demos.
- [Blog](https://theday.id/blog): Articles on wedding preparation and using Theday.

## Features (currently live)

- [Digital wedding invitations](https://theday.id/templates): Flagship. 30+ elegant, customizable templates (colors, fonts, music) shared via a single link. Phase 2 (The Day).
- Online RSVP: Guests confirm attendance directly on the invitation link; filter and export guest data. Phase 2.
- Guest list management: Organize and track invited guests. Phases 1–2.
- Wishes / ucapan: Guests leave messages on the invitation. Phase 2.
- Digital gift / amplop digital: Cashless gifting (Premium feature). Phase 2.
- Preparation checklist: Basic wedding-prep checklist. Phase 1 (Before).
- Support chat: In-app customer support, available across phases.

## Pricing

- Free plan: Core digital invitation and basics at no cost.
- Premium plan: Paid upgrade unlocking premium templates and features (e.g. digital gift). See the pricing section on the home page for current details.

## Roadmap (NOT yet available — do not present as live)

- Phase 1 (Before): full budget tracker, expanded wedding planner.
- Phase 2 (The Day): QR check-in, live streaming.
- Phase 3 (After / life together): anniversary tracker & reminders, newlywed admin helpers, joint budget, memory album, date-night planner, couple goals. Targeted gradually through 2026.
